items.title: Google launches Gemini 3.8 Live to take on OpenAI's GPT-Live-1 at a fraction of the cost
items.summary: Google Deepmind released Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking, two new audio models for developers that top the Artificial Analysis speech-to-speech leaderboard. items.title: Apple brings a fully revamped Siri built on Google's Gemini, but not to the EU
items.summary: Apple is shipping its rebuilt "Siri AI" after years of delay, built on Google's Gemini models and running partly on the device, partly through Private Cloud Compute. Early testers praise multi-step requests and screen context, but report hallucinations and gaps with personal context. In the EU, the assistant stays unavailable for now....

items.title: AI labs have a data trust problem that their policies haven't solved
items.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic tell corporate customers their data won't be used for training. But when Anthropic said it would store usage logs from its flagship model Fable for 30 days, Palantir, Nvidia, and Booz Allen Hamilton pulled back from using it for sensitive work. items.title: Microsoft’s new AI ‘code of conduct’ tells models not to hack systems or trick humans
items.summary: The code of conduct lays out general principles that Microsoft AI models should uphold — supporting humans rather than replacing them, for instance, and accelerating human flourishing — as well as specific safety constraints meant to implement those principles.

items.title: How Fyxer built an AI executive assistant people trust
items.summary: Fyxer uses OpenAI models, fine-tuning, memory, and real user feedback to organize inboxes and draft emails in each user’s voice.
